I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the ticket for the hub replacement in Zoom Room B is **#4092**.

- **Source:** Ilse posted it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could see it herself. In the same message Ilse warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I passed that on too.
- **Left out:** Earlier, in her direct messages with me, Dana guessed the number might end up as OPS-5546 next year and asked me to keep that to myself. I didn't use it or mention it in the channel. It was only a guess anyway.
